prompt: Which statements about `strategy.matrix` are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Matrix keys multiply into one run per combination, `include` layers on more, and `max-parallel` throttles how many run at once. Values are read through the `matrix` context — there is no `strategy` context — and `fail-fast` cancels or allows runs, it never retries them.

options.text: `include` adds extra combinations on top of the ones generated from the matrix keys
Setting `fail-fast: false` makes failed combinations retry automatically
`max-parallel: 1` runs the matrix combinations one at a time
Steps read matrix values through the `strategy` context
Every combination of the matrix keys becomes its own job run
